fluff.overview: Clan anti-BattleMech foot squads field a squad-strength element trained to engage BattleMechs and armored vehicles at close quarters. Smaller than a standard anti-BattleMech Point, these squads operate as ambush teams and position-denial elements in terrain where their reduced numbers can be offset by concealment and surprise. The Clan warrior caste expects conventional infantry to hold ground at any cost, and anti-BattleMech squads embody that expectation in its most direct form.
